name: Goodfellow AFB
description: Home of the 17th Training Wing, Goodfellow AFB trains intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and fire protection professionals. Major hub for ISR training.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (Kearney Blvd)
gates.notes: Primary visitor processing and 24/7 access point.

gates.name: South Gate
gates.notes: Alternate access for south side facilities.
gates.address: S Gate Rd, Goodfellow AFB, TX 76908

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Visitor passes and registration at Main Gate area.

resources.name: Main Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC serving permanent party and students with full meal service.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0630-0830, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1700-1900; weekends vary

resources.name: Goodfellow AFB Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, food court, gas station, and barber shop.

resources.name: Goodfellow AFB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency full-service grocery store.

resources.name: First Financial Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union with checking, loans, and ATM services.

resources.name: Goodfellow Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports courts.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2200; Sat-Sun 0800-1800; 24/7 for registered CAC holders

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for students and permanent party.

resources.name: Goodfellow Inn / AF Lodging
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and readiness services.

resources.name: 17th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, RV storage, and recreational programs.

resources.name: 17th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, TRICARE support, and emergency services coordination.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: Main Gate area, Goodfellow AFB, TX 76908

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (325-654-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Goodfellow Inn (325-654-3311) for temporary lodging.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 17 TRW FSS and M&FRC for in-processing and community support.
